newsitem.title: USA: Stockpile issues new ferro-manganese solicitation.
newsitem.headline: Stockpile issues new ferro-manganese solicitation.

text.p: The Defense National Stockpile Center said it has issued a new soliciation offering 19,482 short tons (bulk weight) of medium carbon ferro-manganese, containing 32,049,630 lbs of contained manganese.
Stockpile said all restrictions on the sale of ferro-manganese apply to high carbon material only. There are no restrictions on medium-carbon material, Stockpile said.

The first offering of medium carbon ferro-manganese will be on July 8. If all the material is not sold on that day, subsequent offerings will occur on the second Tuesday of each month, Stockpile said.
Meanwhile the next offering of high carbon ferro-manganese will be on June 24.
